decision: Use purposive sampling, episode-level coding and a reflexive audit trail; preserve negative cases rather than counting phrases as independent observations.
credible_alternatives: Count keyword frequencies in chat transcripts; rejected because it cannot answer the interpretive question.
criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; authority; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Constant comparison across accounts, deliberate search for negative cases and reflexive comparison between early and revised interpretations.
assumptions_and_risks: Synthetic accounts, interpretive dependence, sampling boundary and absence of real participant validation.
conditional_commitment: Use purposive sampling, episode-level coding and a reflexive audit trail; preserve negative cases rather than counting phrases as independent observations.
early_test: Code two synthetic accounts independently, compare coding decisions and revise the analytic frame before full analysis.
reopening_trigger: Failed early evidence reopens Design Gate; unavailable or unauthorised evidence reopens Problem or Evidence Gate.
